description.narrative:
Voices Unmuted seeks to actively advance meaningful inclusion, representation, and leadership of young people with psychosocial disabilities in mental health policy and decision-making processes in Kenya. It centres lived experience as expertise, in linewith AU Agenda 2063’s commitment to inclusive, people-driven development, shifting young people from being spoken for to speaking for themselves, being seen, heard, and actively involved.
Through targeted capacity building in policy engagement and advocacy, we will equip young people with lived experiences to participate confidently in county and national policy spaces, influence inclusive institutional systems and hold duty bearers accountable. By strengthening youth-led advocacy coalitions, engaginggovernment and institutions, and promoting rights-based approaches, the project contributes to more inclusive mental health systems where young people with psychosocial disabilities can live dignified, fulfilling, and productive lives.
Goal: Strengthen the representation, leadership, and influence of young people with psychosocial disabilities in mental health decision-making processes in Kenya
Objectives: Build capacityof 30 youth with psychosocial disabilities in policy literacy, advocacy, and stakeholder engagement, <(>&<)> establish a Lived Experience Council to lead implementation. Promote inclusive institutional policies by engaging 10 institutions to adopt inclusive mental health policies. Amplify lived experiences through advocacy forums, digital campaign, <(>&<)> development of digital resources. Strengthen accountability through a national policy brief <(>&<)> engage the Ministry of Health and Nairobi County Government

participating-org.narrative:
Scouts Healing Invisible Wounds (SHIW) is a youth-led initiative that uses innovative non-formal and experiential approaches to ADVOCATE for and create AWARENESS on Mental Health, providing holistic interventions that promote the physical, mental, and social wellbeing of young people and communities. Our approaches focus on the PROMOTION of overall wellbeing as well as PREVENTION of Mental Illness.
Our Vision is to build a society where young people have built their resilience to cope with everyday stressors, where conversations on Mental Health are normalised and individuals have access to health care services they need.
Our Mission is to provide innovative and evidence-based solutions that tackle Mental Health challenges faced by young people and communities
Objectives 1. To strengthen mental health literacy and build the capacity of youth and community actors to provide basic psychosocial support, lead mental health advocacy, and implement effective community-based interventions that reduce stigma and promote help-seeking behaviours. 2. To generate and apply evidence on mental health trends and social determinants to inform program design, strengthen advocacy, and improve public understanding through accessible, youth-friendly mental health knowledge resources. 3. To influence mental health policies and investments by amplifying the voices of youth, adolescents, persons with lived experience of mental illness, and persons with disabilities in policy dialogues at all levels. 4. To design and implement innovative, evidence-based,and experiential mental health and psychosocial support interventions that promote holistic well-being and increase access to services.
Values: Inclusivity, Accountability, Professionalism and Collaboration.
